artworks.title: Ernest, Count of Mansfeld
artworks.description: The image shows a bust-length portrait of a man. He is facing forward with his head slightly turned to his right. He has detailed facial features, a mustache, a pointed beard, and a calm expression. His hair is moderate in length and styled with curls. He is dressed in elaborate 17th-century clothing, including a lace collar, a patterned garment, and a dark cape draped over one shoulder. The frame is ornate with scrollwork and inscriptions. The background has an engraved texture, and there is additional text below the portrait.

artworks.title: Maria of Austria, Infanta of Spain
artworks.description: The image features an engraving of the upper portion of a woman's body. The woman is facing forward with her body slightly turned to the right, and her gaze is towards the viewer. She has an oval face with finely arched eyebrows, a straight nose, and a small, closed mouth. Her hair is styled in an elaborate way, pulled back and adorned with a decorative band or crown. She wears a richly decorated garment with a high lace collar, intricate patterns, and a large bow or sash on her right shoulder. Around her neck, she wears multiple strands of a necklace. The background is designed as an oval frame with an inscription and decorative elements resembling fabric. Below the oval frame, there is a block of Latin text.

artworks.title: Maria of Austria, Infanta of Spain
artworks.description: The image depicts an upper-body portrait of a woman facing forward. She has a composed expression with delicate features, expressive eyes, and curly hair styled elegantly on top of her head. She is dressed in ornate attire with a lace ruff around her neck, intricate patterns, and embellishments. She wears pearl earrings. The background features an oval frame with decorative scrollwork and inscriptions. Text at the bottom of the illustration identifies her.

artworks.title: James Montagu, Bishop of Winchester
artworks.description: The image displays an illustration of a seated man from the waist up. He has a full beard, a composed expression, and his gaze faces forward. He wears a ruff collar, a wide-brimmed hat, and formal clothing with intricate patterns. The man holds a closed book with both hands. The background includes decorative scrollwork, text, and a coat of arms above the man's head. The border is detailed with symbols framing the portrait.

artworks.title: Sir Robert Naunton
artworks.description: The image features an upper-body portrait of a man with a serious expression, high cheekbones, a neatly trimmed mustache and beard, and closely cropped hair. He wears elaborate clothing typical of the period, including a detailed patterned doublet with a high, ruffled collar and cuffs, fastened with a belt. The man is holding a small folded paper with one hand resting on the table beside him. On the table, there are various objects: a small bell-shaped item, a piece of paper with writing, and what appears to be a dish with no visible contents. The background has a dark, textured pattern, with two heraldic shields or crests and accompanying Latin text that enhance the formal and distinguished atmosphere of the portrait.

artworks.title: Charles Howard, First Earl of Nottingham
artworks.description: The image displays an engraved portrait of a man, depicted from the upper half, facing the viewer directly. The man has a serious expression, with distinct facial features including a long straight nose, furrowed brows, and deep-set eyes. His hair and beard are neatly styled, with short hair and a trimmed beard. He is dressed in an ornate historical outfit, complete with a ruffled collar, a sash across his chest, and a decorative chain with medallions. He holds an orb or globe in his hand. The background features an oval frame with text describing the individual, along with a textured backdrop. The engraver's inscription and a coat of arms are present below the portrait within the frame.

artworks.title: Sir Thomas Overbury
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man's upper-body portrait within an oval frame. The man has distinct facial features, a short beard, and a styled upward and back hairstyle. He wears a formal outfit with a large lace collar. The engraving is surrounded by an inscription in Latin and English script. The background has textured lines, and decorative patterns and text are present outside the oval frame.

artworks.title: Sir Thomas Overbury
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a man. He is depicted from the waist up, facing slightly to the side but looking directly at the viewer. The man has a neatly trimmed beard and mustache, with curly hair that is combed back from his forehead. He is wearing a formal, period-appropriate outfit with a high lace collar and detailed embellishments on the front of his clothing. He is encircled by an oval border with the words "THE LIVELY PICTURE OF SIR THOMAS OVERBURY" around it. There are no visible jewelry or objects in his hands. The background of the illustration is a simple, lined texture. Beneath the portrait, a section of text in an old-style script provides a poetic verse.

artworks.title: Sir Thomas Overbury
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of Sir Thomas Overbury framed within an oval border. It depicts his upper body up to the chest, positioned facing slightly to his left, looking directly at the viewer with a slight smile. Sir Thomas Overbury has neatly combed, short hair with a pronounced peak at the top, and a light mustache and beard. He is dressed in an elaborate dark doublet with a textured collar featuring intricate lacework. Surrounding the portrait, there is text providing his name and additional inscription below it. The background is a simple, evenly shaded area inside the oval border.

artworks.title: Sir Thomas Overbury
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of Sir Thomas Overbury. He is depicted facing slightly to the right, with his head turned towards the viewer. Overbury has a high forehead, sharp nose, and a trimmed beard with a mustache. His hair is curly with a receding hairline. He is wearing an elaborate garment with a ruffled collar and buttons down the front. The background is simple with an ornate border surrounding the portrait. The inscribed text identifies him as Sir Thomas Overbury with additional script at the bottom of the engraving.

artworks.title: Sir Thomas Overbury
artworks.description: This image shows a waist-up portrait of a man seated and facing forward. His facial features include a high forehead, prominent cheekbones, a small mustache, and a short pointed beard. His hair is neatly combed and appears to be dark in color. He is wearing a formal period outfit with a large lace ruff around his neck, a detailed buttoned doublet, and puffed sleeves. Additionally, there is an oval frame around the portrait with the inscription "THE LIVELY PORTRAITURE OF SIR THOMAS OVERBURY Aetatis suae 32." The background consists of intricately lined patterns. Below the portrait, there is a block of printed text in ornate script. The overall presentation is that of an engraved portrait.

artworks.title: Mary Sidney, Countess of Pembroke
artworks.description: The engraving presents a portrait of a woman from the waist up, facing forward. She has curly hair, defined features, and a composed expression. She wears a gown with a lace collar and cuffs, layered pearl necklaces, and holds a book marked "David’s Psalms." The woman also wears drop earrings. The frame around her features decorative scrollwork and the inscription "MARY SIDNEY Countess of Pembroke." The background is filled with etched textures and patterns.

artworks.title: Mary Sidney, Countess of Pembroke
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman from the waist up, facing forward with her body slightly turned to her left. She has a neutral expression and curly hair. She wears an elaborate dress with a lace collar and detailed embroidery, along with a beaded pearl necklace and drop pearl earrings. She holds an open book or pamphlet with the text "David Psalms" visible. The background is an ornate oval frame.

artworks.title: Philip Herbert, Fourth Earl of Pembroke
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up, facing slightly to the right with his head turned towards the viewer. He has wavy hair, a mustache, and a goatee. He is dressed in an Elizabethan-style outfit with a high lace ruff collar, an embellished coat, and a pendant around his neck. The background features an ornate oval frame with scrollwork decorations and text indicating the person's identity and titles.

artworks.title: Philip Herbert, Fourth Earl of Pembroke
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man seated with his upper body visible. His body is turned slightly to the right, and he has a direct gaze, a slender face, pronounced cheekbones, and a defined mustache and goatee. His curly hair flows to his collar. He wears an ornate garment with intricate patterns, a high lace collar, and a medallion on a chain around his neck. The background includes an ornate oval frame with scroll-like decorations above and below, topped by a coat of arms. The frame is inscribed with text including titles, with additional script at the bottom for identification.

artworks.title: William Herbert, Third Earl of Pembroke
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man. He is positioned facing slightly to the right, with his eyes looking towards the viewer. The man has a mustache, beard, wavy medium-length hair, and is dressed in aristocratic clothing typical of the era. He wears a dark doublet, high lace collar, and a sash. In his right hand, he holds a baton or staff. Surrounding him is an intricate frame with banners showing the name "H. GUIL: EM: HERBERIT DE CARD" and other titles. Above him is an ornate coat of arms. The background features lines creating a textured pattern.

artworks.title: William Herbert, Third Earl of Pembroke

He has a trimmed beard and mustache, wavy hair, and is dressed in elaborate clothing with a lace ruff around his neck. He holds a staff or baton in his right hand. The portrait is set in an ornate oval frame with ribbons and an inscription, with a coat of arms at the top. The background features intricate lines and scrollwork.

artworks.title: William Herbert, Third Earl of Pembroke
artworks.description: This image is an engraved portrait showing the upper half of a man's body. The man is in a formal pose with his hand resting on a sword. He has a prominent mustache and beard, a serious expression, and full, slightly wavy hair. He wears elaborate clothing of the period, including a ruffled collar, ornate robes, and a decorated sash. A medallion is visible around his neck, along with a decorative oval frame in the background with scrollwork, inscriptions, and a coat of arms. The lower portion of the image features additional ornate scrollwork with identifying inscriptions.

artworks.title: William Herbert, Third Earl of Pembroke
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a man from the waist up, positioned facing slightly to his right, with his left arm bent and resting on his hip, holding a staff or rod with his right hand. He has a well-groomed beard and mustache, with wavy, medium-length hair styled back. He is wearing an ornate, high-collared ruff and luxurious clothing typical of historical nobility, featuring detailed patterns and a cape draped over his shoulders. The background is an intricately designed frame with decorative banners, scrollwork, and a coat of arms at the top center above the man’s head, along with textual elements that describe his titles and honors. The portrait is elegantly bordered.

artworks.title: Sir Walter Raleigh
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of the upper half of a man with an oval face, sharp facial features, short wavy hair, a short beard and mustache. He is dressed in an ornate garment with lace ruff. He holds a quill pen. The background features a frame with decorative swirls, an architectural motif, a coat of arms, Latin text, and an English inscription identifying him as Sir Walter Ralegh with a crest.

artworks.title: Sir Walter Raleigh
artworks.description: This image shows a man seated in a dignified pose. He has prominent facial features including a high forehead, deep-set eyes, prominent cheekbones, a neatly trimmed mustache and beard, and short, wavy hair. He is dressed in elaborate Elizabethan attire, with a detailed doublet and a large, ruffled lace collar. The man is holding a baton or rod in one hand and resting the other on a book. In the background, there is a decorative oval frame with Latin inscriptions, scrolls, and a small shield with a coat of arms. The print includes text describing the person's attributes and ornate crests.

artworks.title: Sir Walter Raleigh
artworks.description: This is an engraved portrait showing most of the person's upper body. The person is positioned facing forward with a slight turn to his left. He has a prominent nose, a neatly trimmed mustache and beard, short, combed back hair, and a distinguished facial expression. He is wearing an ornate garment typical of the Elizabethan era with a prominent ruff collar, detailed patterns, a sash across his chest, and sleeves with intricate designs. The person holds a slender rod or baton in his right hand. Surrounding the portrait is an oval frame with text and decorative elements like scrolls and foliage. Below the image is an inscription with an elaborate coat of arms and the phrase "AMORE ET VIRTUTE." The background features detailed engravings and text providing context to the person's identity and honorifics.

artworks.title: Sir Walter Raleigh
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraved portrait of a man in Elizabethan-era clothing. The man is seated, facing forward, with a pointed mustache, a small beard, and neatly combed back hair. He wears elaborate attire with intricate embroidery, including a doublet with puffed sleeves and a ruffled collar. He is holding a map and a staff in his right hand. The oval-framed portrait is surrounded by ornate scrollwork, text likely identifying the man as Sir Walter Raleigh, and decorative elements like a face at the top and a coat of arms.

artworks.title: Sir Walter Raleigh
artworks.description: The engraving depicts a portrait of Sir Walter Raleigh. Raleigh, with a beard and mustache, is shown facing forward in ornate Elizabethan attire. He holds a staff or baton in his hand. The portrait is surrounded by floral decorations, text naming Raleigh, a crest, and an inscription.
